### Formula for Resistivity using Four-Probe Method
$$\rho = \frac{\pi t}{\ln(2)} \times \frac{V}{I} = 4.532 \times t \times \frac{V}{I}$$
where $\rho$ is resistivity, $t$ is the thickness of the sample, $V$ is the measured voltage, and $I$ is the applied current.

### Typical Band Gap Range for Intrinsic Semiconductors
The typical forbidden energy band gap range for intrinsic semiconductors is **$0.7\text{ eV to } 1.1\text{ eV}$** (e.g., Germanium is $\approx 0.72\text{ eV}$, Silicon is $\approx 1.1\text{ eV}$).
proTip: Remember to state the geometric correction factor $4.532$ or $\pi / \ln(2)$ clearly in the four-probe method formula.
